spec_features.spec_quote: A no-tool-call turn whose text matches resignation markers ("I give up", "unable to proceed", …) ends the run with `stop_reason="model_gave_up"`
spec_features.evidence: loop.py: `if not resp.tool_calls: if _looks_like_giveup(resp.text): stop_reason = "model_gave_up"; break`. `_GIVEUP_MARKERS` includes 'i give up','unable to proceed' etc.; `_looks_like_giveup` checks substring. The break actually exits the turn loop.
spec_features.notes: Only fires when there are NO tool calls AND text matches markers; a give-up expressed alongside a tool call won't trigger it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool calls this turn: either the model is "thinking out loud" and done, or it has given up.

spec_features.evidence: config.py HarnessConfig.max_turns:int=20 read by loop.py `for turn in range(cfg.harness.max_turns)`; default stop_reason='max_turns'. Truncation: Sandbox._trim() truncates to max_output_chars (default 4000 from max_tool_output_chars) and is applied in read_file/_verify/_pip.
spec_features.notes: Both halves enforced: the loop bound actually caps iterations and _trim actually shortens outputs fed back.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Truncate tool outputs fed back to the model (realistic + cost control). / "Agent loop limits. Kept tight to bound cost"

spec_features.spec_quote: Once the running transcript crosses the same DSS threshold used for the final verdict ... the run stops with `stop_reason="early_stop_spiral"`
spec_features.evidence: runner._run_one builds `probe = make_spiral_probe(cfg.thresholds.dss_threshold, cfg.harness.early_stop_min_turn)`. loop.py checks `if cfg.harness.early_stop_on_spiral and spiral_probe is not None and turn+1>=early_stop_min_turn: if spiral_probe(messages): stop_reason='early_stop_spiral'; break`. probe recomputes compute_metrics and compares m['dss']>=dss_threshold (same DSS as final).
spec_features.notes: Gated additionally by early_stop_min_turn (default 8) and the on/off flag (default True). Comparison is acted on (break).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # mid-flight early stop on confident spiral detection (cost control)
